value.rationale: A natural network modification (one antipodal matching edge per site) gives three distinct changes to a standard reversible dynamical invariant, increasing the clock at d=2, decreasing it at d=3 and d=5, yet giving a universal clock 60 from d>=6. This sharp nonmonotone, exact all-dimensional result is not mere arbitrary finite tabulation; complete primitive-period and dominant-period formulas quantify the mechanism. It may be useful as a rigorous benchmark for topology-dependent finite-field reversible dynamics. Limit: significance is specialized to characteristic five and this graph pair.
